summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers (monai/data/csv_saver.py, monai/data/nifti_saver.py) and the plot_2d_or_3d_image function in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler as thin adapters that delegate to these. Changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in the three in-repo callers. Updated test_handler_classification_saver.py and added test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and test_handler_segmentation_saver.py. Nothing was run; verification was by reading the code only (line lengths, trailing newlines, comma spacing checked). No commits made. Beyond the spec: the CSV finalize skips blank rows in an existing file.
